summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed) and routed every rounding through it; removed the decimal context line. Batch pool threads historically rounded context-dependent figures (band charges, effective price) half-even while the main thread rounded half-up, so that is preserved via a keyword-only `method`. Kept quirks: whole-unit payable never shows negative zero; products/quotients beyond 28 digits are no longer context-rounded half-up.
